name: Bootstrap Components
description: Lightweight Bootstrap 5 SDC component collection with a custom to_attributes Twig filter.
project_description: Bootstrap Components is a lean, dependency-free collection of Bootstrap 5 Single Directory Components (SDC) for Drupal 10/11. It ships 21 ready-to-use components (accordion, alert, blockquote, breadcrumb, button, card family, carousel, close-button, dropdown, modal, nav, navbar, offcanvas, pagination, tooltip) each defined as an SDC with typed props, named slots and variants, plus a single Twig extension exposing a to_attributes filter/function that normalizes strings, class lists and associative arrays into a Drupal Attribute object. It provides no entities, routes, permissions, config or block plugins — components are pure theming/authoring constructs invokable from Twig, other components, Layout Builder or any SDC consumer. Structure is intentionally a slimmer, easier-to-audit subset inspired by ui_suite_bootstrap, and it assumes Bootstrap 5 CSS/JS (and Popper) are already loaded by your theme.
